changes.text: Fix large bulky toys from being stored in suit storage

changes.text: Fix some erroneous dream portents from showing up

author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Things that interrupted the opening of storages are no longer reliant on a runtime, meaning they interrupt regardless of whether you had another open storage open at the time

changes.text: Fixed color matrix not applying in reskinnable item preview.

changes.text: Blood from blood bags is fully synthetic

changes.text: fixes mining mobs being able to spawn too close to one another under certain circumstances

title: Implements OverFlayer, VV dev tool for debugging appearances and images
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Added a new debug tool which displays a detailed breakdown of in-game visuals

title: Cargo manifest stamp payment consistency
author: lessthnthree

changes.text: Cargo manifest stamp payments/penalties are now consistently applied as a percentage of the order value
Maximum payment for an approved cargo manifest raised to 120cr
Cargo orders that arrive empty and stamped denied receive a full refund regardless of crate return

title: Reverts "Merges ghosts into spirits & a rework", but removes ghosts from Pride's mirror.
author: Y0SH1M4S73R

changes.text: Ghosts and spirits have once again been split into two species. Becoming a ghost is only possible through a lucky polymorph, or the "Forsake Body" spell, available for two points in a wizard's spellbook.
Spirits no longer have the passthrough ability.

Ghost's passthrough ability has unlimited range and no longer leaves behind a grave. It is affected by holy water, and makes you drop all your equipment, along with any bodyparts and organs that are not ghostly in nature.

title: Moves hair and eyes into standing overlays
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Refactored hair and eye rendering a bit, they're now rendered separately to the head - report any oddities with either. Lips too but to a lesser degree.

title: makes chat highlights look WAY better
author: Absolucy

changes.text: Changed how chat highlights are styled - any color should look good now, regardless of light or dark mode.

title: Makes invisimins actually invisible to regular ghosts, plus qol improvements
author: vinylspiders

changes.text: invisimin now makes the admin invisible to ghosts/observers, as well as pierce-immune and able to phase through walls
aghosting while invisimin'd or stealthmin'd will carry over your invisibility to the aghost so you no longer have to trigger it again
added a new admin verb, 'Toggle Admin ESP', which lets you see ghosts and invisimins while active

title: Adds more SeCrEt ChEmS
author: Time-Green

changes.text: Adds three new maintpill-only chems! Go eat more maintpills, and maybe you'll find out what they are :)
Adds a new secret chem, which can rarely be found on a petrified piece of paper somewhere in maintenance...
Fixes miscellaneous sources of petrification lasting 10x as long as intended

title: Fixes clicking on compact defib
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: You can now get the paddles from a compact defib by clicking on it

title: Fix pda messenger splitting all words instead of putting them on new lines
author: strandsofivy

changes.text: The PDA direct messenger will no longer overzealously break words, resulting in cleaner chat message formatting overall.

title: Adds some tier zero (penguin, plant) and a tier one (stoat) gene infusion
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Adds Penguin tier zero gene infusion (gives you penguin ears, which make you waddle)
Adds Plant tier zero gene infusion (gives you plant hair / organs, which do nothing)
Adds Stoat tier one gene infusion (makes you tall, snouted, gives you finer instincts, allows you to dodge large foes)

title: Adds an ingame holiday for Chernobyl Disaster Remembrance Day
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: April 26th is Chernobyl Disaster Remembrance Day.

title: Ghosts now have (better) runechat
author: vinylspiders

changes.text: speeds ghost runechat up a bit, and makes it show as italic
adds a 'toggle dead runechat' admin verb in case you need to disable it midround for an event or something

title: Admins can now varedit blobs to not instantly end the round on victory
author: Hatterhat

changes.text: Admins can now varedit blob overminds (the eye mob) to not kill everyone on the station if they hit critical mass. (Admins will still have to remove the blob from the shuttle subsystem's "hostile environments" tracker, though.)

title: Adds signboards
author: vinylspiders

changes.text: Added a pair of signboards that can be crafted in the crafting menu, a wooden one, and a holographic one. Perfect for advertising or otherwise getting your VERY important message across to passersby.

title: Animated wand of animation works and animated wand of animation animating a wand of animation works
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: animating a wand of animation works, and that animated wand of animation animating a wand of animation does not runtime

title: Fixes maximum time of syndicate bombs and refactors slightly
author: Shroopy

changes.text: Fixed syndicate bombs having a maximum timer of 1000 minutes instead of 100 minutes.

title: [NO GBP] Fixes passive positive virus healing.
author: Higgin

changes.text: positive viruses no longer self-cure when not having spaceacillin or meeting the nutrition/satiety requirements.

title: Adds the E-2 Earthcracker, a traitor tool for premeditated sabotage.
author: ArcaneMusic

changes.text: Adds the E-2 Earthcracker device as a purchasable traitor item for 2 TC. Use it to create potentially devastating weakpoints onto the station!

title: [MDB IGNORE] Adds new features and tiles for lavaland biomes
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Siderite and Shale lavaland biomes now have unique floors, as well as flora, features and fauna!
Fixed some ruins generating with default basalt walls instead of their biome's walls

changes.text: Facial hair color can be separate from hair color again
Hair covering things update when they need up

title: modernizes granibitaluri
author: TheRyeGuyWhoWillNowDie

changes.text: Granibitaluri heals 1.5 brute and burn at best now, and scales down to 0.5 at worst.

title: [I ded] Xenomicrobes and Nanomachines are maintenance pill only
author: Y0SH1M4S73R

changes.text: You can no longer get Xenomicrobes and Nanomachines from botany mutations.

title: Adds a priority targeting framework, and priority targeting to mining mobs
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Mining mobs now use priority when choosing their target, prioritizing NODE drones over miners who haven't attacked them or their allies

title: Spacers are slightly taller again (Reverts "Reverts Makes Spacers Taller")
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Spacers are now "very tall" again, rather than just "decently tall".

title: SyndEye PDA app tracking successfully tracks
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: SyndEye PDA app tracking tracks successfully

title: Removes a rogue syndiedome ruin decal
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Removed a rogue syndiedome ruin decal

changes.text: Drying rack no longer accepts or processes dried items

title: Fixes rotating the crystallizer
author: 1393F

changes.text: The crystallizer can be rotated once again, on left click

author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Tweaks message displayed when examining recovered crew / thanatorenaisa bodies

title: Restores fire alarm sound quality, still keeps them on 1 channel

changes.text: Restored fire alarm sound quality

title: Decouples syndicate monkey from traitor pref, also makes rolebanning work
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: You no longer need traitor on to get syndicate monkey or contractor ghost polls, & banning from these roles bans from the polls as well

title: Lizard frills are hidden by `HIDEHAIR` rather than `HIDEEARS` / Lizard frills are masked like hair by hats
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Some masks no longer hide lizard frills.
Hats that flatten hair now also flatten lizard frills a bit.

title: Reorganizing the non-game UI
author: JohnFulpWillard

changes.text: Reorganized the UI around the game; the title bar has been removed in favor of the old info buttons (top right of the screen), which now has some new buttons for you.
The Status Panel is now able to be retracted with one of the infobuttons.
You can now go directly to your hotkey settings from your hotkeys help page.

title: Gives a new small area for the extinguisher so it aint blocking trashcan
author: Boopideedoo

changes.text: fixes a blocked trashcan from being blocked and moving the item that blocked it to a new area inside the ruin

title: Cuffing items to you now chains you to the item rather than give you nodrop (shields can be cuffed again)
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Cuffing items to yourself no longer prevents you from dropping or being disarmed of the item- instead, the item becomes "chained" to you, forcing it to stay within one tile's reach under all circumstances.
You can cuff shields to yourself again. Unless we figure out it's still oppressive in which case it'll probably be removed (again)
IV drops should break your character's offsets less often

title: Stoat tongue has `TRAIT_SPEAKS_CLEARLY` (fell for it again award)
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: You can speak with a stoat tongue
Stoat infusion is slightly taller

title: You can't dynamite fish from chest cavities
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Explosions won't remove organs from skeletons/plasmamen

title: Fix for RND server being invisible
author: Aliceee2ch

changes.text: RND servers are visible once again.

title: Makes disable dead keyloop lagswitch measure smarter
author: vinylspiders

changes.text: disable dead keyloop lagswitch measure now properly affects new ghosts, and fixes an issue where people can revive and still be frozen

author: CabinetOnFire

changes.text: Fixes the spawn panel being unable to spawn turfs

author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Solar arrays don't check for the pressence of space vines every process tick

author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Re-adding limbs surgically requires you do surgery again (ie, incise -> retract -> clamp).

author: Time-Green

changes.text: Fixes voidwalker being unable to vomit jump if anyone vomits on a non-station z-level

title: You can be wabbajacked into a (sterile) blood worm
author: Y0SH1M4S73R

changes.text: Random polymorphs can turn you into hatchling blood worms that can mature, but not reproduce.

title: Changes how tongues apply `TRAIT_SPEAKS_CLEARLY`
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Changes the way tongues allow you to speak correctly to make them less prone to fault

title: More accurate feedback for action button consciousness check failure
author: Y0SH1M4S73R

changes.text: You are told you are downed instead of unconscious if you attempt to use an action that requires you to be conscious while in softcrit.

title: Block two people cuffing to one item
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Blocks two people cuffing to one item

title: Raptors are now immune to ice, buffs mining MOD digging and changes bombs to missiles
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Mining MOD sphere mode now fires a barrage of micromissiles instead of a singular delayed explosive
Raptor are now immune to ice slippage
Mining MOD has had its ore digging speed increased
Buckled mobs can no longer "slip" (get stunned) on wet/icy tiles.

title: Slight tweaks to flesh spider numbers
author: kuricityy

changes.text: Flesh spiders are now slightly slower than your average spessmen. (10%)
Flesh spiders now regenerate after 3 seconds of not taking damage, compared to 4.

title: Sinks(And other things) clean out petri dishes
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: sinks(and other methods of washing) clean out petri dishes

title: Fix shock immunity flag not working
author: timothymtorres

changes.text: Fix shock immunity flag not working when electrocution occurs

title: Reworks goliaths, slightly changes watchers/legions/brimdemons/lobstrocities
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Goliaths no longer hardstun, but instead bind and drag their targets in with their tentacles. They are, however, much faster now.
Brimdemon beams can no longer wound, but deal a bit more DOT damage. Their beams can also be interrupted by hitting them from the side or back in melee.
Watchers and legions now try to maintain a few tiles of distance from their targets instead of retreating.
Lobstrocity AI should no longer sometimes flee out of their aggro range when retreating.

title: Carnivorous Blood : A new DNA-targeting traitor chemical that eats away at your bloodstream
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Added a new traitor item, Carnivorous Blood. It is purchasable in uplinks. Carnivorous Blood is a reagent that eats away at a victim's blood once in their bloodstream, doing so significantly faster if it has been mixed with the victim's blood beforehand.

title: Surviving heart attacks is not based on whether you recently exercised, but how fit you are.
author: necromanceranne

changes.text: Your overall athletics level is what protects you from a random heart attack. If you achieve peak fitness, you are immune to random heart attacks.

title: makes pyrite/rainbow extract coloring look better (+ minor crossbreed code improvements)
author: Absolucy

changes.text: The color changing from regenerative rainbow, adamantine, and stabilized pyrite extracts now looks far better.
The protection effect from regenerative rainbow extracts now actually makes you all rainbowy.
Minor improvements to crossbreed status effect code.

changes.text: fixes material floor duplication

changes.text: You can unbuckle people from wheelchairs again

changes.text: The door control button in Deltastation's medical desk works again.

author: carpotoxin

changes.text: Adds the Deep Space deathmatch map

title: You can purchase (lower quality) broadcast cameras as a cargo goodie
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: You can purchase (lower quality) broadcast cameras in cargo for 800cr

title: You can now print basic wet floor signs at the Protolathe, because you couldn't actually print them.
author: Iamgoofball

changes.text: You can now print basic wet floor signs at the Service Protolathe, because you couldn't actually print them for decades.

title: Adds screentips to grilles, moves deconstruction to RMB.
author: ArcaneMusic

changes.text: Grills now have screentips when using tools on them.
In-line with other deconstruction processes, grills now deconstruct on right click.

title: Fixes a merge conflict that broke stat panel
author: JohnFulpWillard

changes.text: Stat panel's "Toggle Stat Panel" button now works.

title: Observers can move again
author: JohnFulpWillard

changes.text: People who re-enter their body can now exit again by moving.

title: Changes moon armor knowledge description to be more clear(And not lie)
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: The Moon path armor knowledge's description has been made more clear

title: Buffs the good aspects of Spacer by a little bit, so people might actually notice them
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Spacer: Reduction to cold damage increased from 20% to 33%
Spacer: Reduction to pressure damage increased from 20% to 33%
Spacer: Zero gravity drift speed increased from 20% to 25%
Spacer: Zero gravity floating speed increased from 10% to 15%
Spacer: Move speed penalty on planetary maps reduced from 25% to 15%
Spacer: Passive effects now trigger every second, rather than every three seconds
Spacer: Disgust healing modifier while in zero gravity increased from 1x to 2x
Spacer: Passive stun reduction in zero gravity changed from 3 seconds per 3 seconds to 2 seconds per second
Spacer: Passive stamina healing in zero gravity changed from 3 stamina per 3 seconds to 4 stamina per second
Spacer: Passive stun reduction in zero gravity now activates after 10 seconds in zero gravity, down from 3 minutes
Spacer: Passive stamina healing in zero gravity now activates after 1 minute, down from 3 minutes
Spacer: After being in zero gravity for 10 seconds, also reduces duration of knockdown effects by 25%

title: Bane refactor (now uses damage multipliers)
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Refactored bane, which is the bonus some items get to damage vs specific mob types. Report any oddities or weird damage numbers you notice.
Flyswatter damage scales the same across all mob types (if you get a +3 flyswatter you no longer one shot mothpeople)
Bonus damage from "bane" no longer ignore armor unless the weapon itself does
All bane effects are now agnostic to combat mode, meaning they don't require you be on combat mode to apply the bonus damage.
Item with bane effects have an indicator about their effect in their combat label

title: Fix historian mode sfx
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: sfx that plays when entering historian mode of a trophy case is no longer mute

title: Makes genetics more public
author: Aliceee2ch

changes.text: Genetics Lab was made less secure and more public on every map, try it out!

title: Fix holodeck organ and bodyparts behavior
author: timothymtorres

changes.text: Fix holodeck mob organs and body parts not disappearing. Any holodeck mob organs and body parts can also no longer be bioscrambled.

title: Fixes crab market crash
author: JohnFulpWillard

changes.text: Multiple crab17 crashes will now individually affect you and require you to visit each one.

title: Add human limbs to the holodeck medsim organ crate
author: timothymtorres

changes.text: Add human limbs to the holodeck medsim organ crate

title: Adds `REACTION_TAG_DAMAGING` to Thermite
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Thermite chemical reaction is tagged as "Damaging", making it easier to refer to.

title: Plumbing nit picks & Qol
author: SyncIt21

changes.text: plumbing assimilator has higher heating coefficient to that of tier 3 chem heater

title: Stumps no longer give a reattachment moodlet to mobs
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Stumps no longer give a reattachment moodlet to mobs

title: Adds text to holoparasite granters to show if they've been used
author: Grmmis

changes.text: Guardian granters (holoparasites injectors, dusty shards, etc) now show if they've been used on examine.

title: [Icebox] Half remaps security, deletes the labor shuttle because it made no sense
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: [Icebox] Security saw a minor remapping, with most notably the removal of the labor shuttle and the integration of the labor camp into the bottom floor of the perma-brig.

title: Fixes keybinds menu capitalization
author: emicchinya

changes.text: Target Left arm, Right arm, Left leg and Cycle head keybinds are now capitalized properly.

title: bluespace launchpad icon fixes, launchpad remote reset button fix, deep fryer icon fix
author: Hatterhat

changes.text: Bluespace launchpads are no longer invisible when deployed.
Briefcase launchpad remotes now have a functioning reset button.
Quantum pads now use their screwdrivered-open state when depowered.
Deep fryers now have a sprite with an open maintenance panel instead of becoming invisible when screwdrivered.
